cases.name: bug-and-test
cases.audit: Changed assertion directly exercises the corrected negative-input branch.

cases.name: utf8-limit-and-test

files.before:
def fits(text, limit):
    return len(text) <= limit
files.after:
def fits(text, limit):
    return len(text.encode("utf-8")) <= limit

cases.audit: Assertion distinguishes character count from byte count in the changed limit.

cases.name: shared-name-independent
cases.audit: Distinct numeric parsing and error-message behavior; repeated symbol validate is not shared behavior.

cases.name: same-directory-independent
cases.audit: Two independently observable transformations, no cross dependency.

cases.name: caller-needs-api
cases.audit: New caller imports a newly added API; old API is retained, addition stands alone.

cases.name: reverse-api-dependency
cases.audit: A adds an independent API; B switches to it, so B cannot precede A.

cases.name: same-value-ambiguous
cases.audit: Could be one timeout policy or two independent adjustments; no caller/requirement evidence.

cases.name: feature-flag-ambiguous
cases.audit: Two flags enabled; rollout coupling or independent toggles both plausible without requirements.
